title: Compact-support reduction tower datum
statement: Let $\ell$ be a prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite extension, $R=\mathcal O_E$ its valuation ring, and $\varpi$ its uniformizer. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a separated finite-type morphism of schemes and fix a compactification $c=(X\xhookrightarrow{j}\overline X\xrightarrow{p}Y)$. On the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] let $B_W=\varprojlim_{m\geq1}(R/\varpi^m)_W$, $\mathcal A_W=\operatorname{Mod}(B_W)$, and $D(\mathcal A_W)$ its unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write $\operatorname{Tow}(\mathcal A_Y)=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf N_{\geq1}^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal A_Y)$. A compact-support reduction tower datum consists of the following data: an exact $R$-linear functor $T:D(\mathcal A_X)\to D(\operatorname{Tow}(\mathcal A_Y))$; normalized $R$-actions on $\mathcal A_X,\mathcal A_Y$ induced by constant sections; natural evaluation isomorphisms $\operatorname{ev}_m T\simeq\operatorname{Res}_m Rp_{*,m}j_!(-\otimes^L_{B_X}(R/\varpi^m)_X)$ identifying every transition for $m\geq r\geq1$ with the prescribed quotient-induced compact-support transition, as in [lem-weil-compact-support-reduction-tower-functor]; and a total right-derived inverse-limit functor $L:D(\operatorname{Tow}(\mathcal A_Y))\to D(\mathcal A_Y)$. The latter carries a natural transformation $Q\circ\varprojlim\to L\circ Q$ on complexes exhibiting it as the right derived functor, invertible on K-injective complexes, and natural projections $L\to\operatorname{ev}_m$. After precomposing with the derived-functor unit, each projection is exactly the image under $Q$ of the ordinary inverse-limit projection. Here $Q$ denotes localization of cochain complexes at quasi-isomorphisms, and the index $i\in\mathbf N$ in the Lean representation denotes the positive exponent $i+1$. Assume that $D(\mathcal A_Y)$ has countable products. The datum includes the tower's shift comparison and triangulatedness; no arbitrary choice from a bare existence assertion is made.
